title: Scheduler timeout
notes: `pf_scheduler_restart` removes a running timeout and calls `pf_scheduler_add` with its own `cb` parameter, so the site inside it is a forwarding site; calls to `pf_scheduler_restart` are matched by the second send matcher.

title: Application callback
notes: The stack calls the application through `net->fspm_cfg.<name>_cb`. This repository contains no application, so the only registrations found are in the integration test fixture (`test/utils_for_testing.cpp`); they are left unconfirmed on purpose.

title: Background worker event
notes: `pf_bg_worker_start_job` sets one event bit per job; `bg_worker_task` waits on the event and tests each bit. The dispatcher connection `bg.dispatch` confirms the bits tested there.
